name: finland-vat-return
description: Prepare and review an ordinary Finland VAT return for 2026. Establish registration, supply location, tax point, taxable consideration and rate before assigning return fields. Covers domestic sales, ordinary EU goods and services, exports, import VAT including the Åland tax border, construction reverse charge, input deductions, mixed use, passenger vehicles and property investment adjustments. Includes the current and preceding-year small-business test, 2026 reduced rates, filing periods, corrections and statutory sanctions. Trigger on Finnish VAT, ALV-ilmoitus, OmaVero, reverse charge, EU sale, import or deductible input VAT. Use with vat-workflow-base and eu-vat-directive; special margin, travel, marketplace and other sector schemes need separately verified treatment.
